Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

SPECIFICATION FOR 
GAUGE FOR INTRAMEDULLARY NAILS 






CO 



1. Scope — Dimensional and other requirements of gauge used to check the diameter of Kuntscher 

intramedullary nails. «_■■.. 

2- Material —Stainless steel conforming to Designation 30Cr13 of IS ; 6911-1972 * Specification for 
stainless steel plate, sheet and strip.'. 



3. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1.

Note — The values for the hole diameters d 1 to rfxs are: 3, 3'5, 4, 4'5, 5, 5*5, 6, 6*5, 7, 7*5, 8, 
8-5, 9, 9*5, 10, 10*5, 11 and 12 respectively. 

All dimensions in millimetres. 

FIG. 1 GAUGE FOR INTRAMEDULLARY NAILS 

3.1 Tolerance — Tolerance zone D9 specified in Table IX of IS: 919-1963 Recommendations for 
limits and fits for engineering (revised) ' shall apply to the hole diameters. 

4. Heat Treatment — The gauge shall be hardened and tempered to 500 to 550 HV. 

5. Workmanship and Finish 

5.1 All edges of the gauge shall be rounded. 

5.2 The gauge shall be free from burrs, cracks, laminations and othq£ surface defects. 

5.3 The gauge shall be passivated and finished mat. 

5.4 All diameter markfngs shall be neat and bold with a minimum of 3 mm height. 

6. Marking — The gauge shall be marked with the manufacturer's name, initials or recognized 
trade-mark; and the country of manufacture. 

6.1 ISI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution, New 
Delhi 110001. 

7. Packing — As agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier.
